title: Clarify declared word-reader comment for the quoted Windows pwsh wrapper exception
outcome: The engram_declared_words comment describes the shared rule for unquoted wrapper shell words and identifies the separate quoted Windows pwsh.exe envelope rule without changing recognition behavior.
acceptance: The comment above engram_declared_words no longer claims that every wrapper shell word passes engram_declared_program_word; it states that the shared rule applies to unquoted shell words and agrees with engram_declared_wrapper_script.
